title: Playground
description: The plain viewer with every option, theme token and built-in control in one panel. Show only a clade, collapse clades or weakly supported branches. Try it on trees from 6 tips to 2.4 million, or on a file of your own. The URL keeps your settings, so a view can be shared.

title: Tree explorer
description: The styled showcase of the library, an alternative to the playground: a toolbar and a ⋮ menu, a choice of what a click does, a node menu, show only a clade, ladderise, search, minimap and export, built on <TreeView> and tree-ops, with a theme made only of CSS custom properties. Every tree of the playground, up to 2.4 million tips, or a file of your own.

title: GBIF names and links
description: A Newick tree whose tips are matched to GBIF taxa by a CSV, shown with the public API: tip names as the tree has them, as GBIF interprets them, or both, and a popup per tip or named node linking to the taxon and an occurrence search on gbif.org. A tip with no match is reported, not hidden. The same data on a map is the GBIF map view.
